{{Quote|Light freighter Longshot, you've just broken every procedure in the manual for departing Coruscant. Please proceed to impound station Trill Aurek Papa for inspection.|Han Solo is told to report to a impound station|<ref name="Aby" />}}
'''Impound stations''' were areas to which [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were sent if they violated the flight procedures of [[Coruscant Air Traffic Control/Legends|Galactic City Air Traffic Control]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The legendary [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was told to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the vessel [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Longshot'']] to an impound station designated [[Impound station Trill Aurek Papa]] after he broke every departure procedure while trying to leave Coruscant. Solo however ignored the order and proceed to depart from the planet.<ref name="Aby" />
